MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 125, October 25, 1937 ]
CREATING A LIGHTHOUSE BOARD
In order to systematize and coordinate the establishment and improvement of lighthouses and other aids to
navigation in the Philippines, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby create a Lighthouse Board composed of the Director of Coasts Surveys, as
Chairman, and the Supervising Inspector of Hulls and Boilers, Bureau of Customs, the Surveyor of the Port,
Bureau of Customs, the Supervising Portworks Engineer, Bureau of Public Works and the President of the
Philippine Ship Owners’ Association, or his representative, as members.
The duties of this Board shall be as follows:
1. To determine upon the location and type of lighthouses, buoys, or beacons to be established or constructed
in the Philippines.
2. To pass upon all applications for the establishment or improvement of lighthouses and other aids to
navigation.
3. To study and submit recommendations to the Office of the President for the improvement of aids to
navigation and the lighthouse service in general.
This Board shall serve without compensation.
Executive Order Numbered Three hundred forty-one, series of nineteen hundred and thirty-one, and other
Orders and regulations in conflict herewith are hereby revoked.
Done at the City of Manila, this twenty-fifth day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
